### Ark Taken to Jerusalem - Bible Pathway - April 13, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-april-13-2012.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 6:2
Points:
- David desired Jerusalem to be the center of worship, not merely a political capital.
- He recognized that his royal authority ultimately depended on submission to the invisible King of kings.
- Michal despised David when he set aside royal majesty to wear a humble linen ephod before God.
- David was willing to lower himself and be lightly esteemed if it brought honor to the Lord.
- True spiritual greatness stems from humility rather than pride or worldly position.
